snippet.title: PALM CITY - Co-op Heist Game | Official Gameplay Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
PALM CITY is a first-person co-op heist game set in a sunny open city. Steal, plan, escape - solo or with friends.

🎮 WISHLIST ON STEAM: PALM CITY

Start small: snatch bags from tourists on the boardwalk. Then move up - break into apartments, hit the city bank, outrun the police. And finally prepare for the big one: the heist against Palm City's most powerful mob boss.

But the loot has to be split. And not everyone in your crew wants to share.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
WHAT'S IN THE GAME
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
• Play solo or in online co-op with friends
• Rob tourists, apartments, stores and the city bank
• Escalating jobs - from petty theft to the ultimate heist
• Split the loot… or betray your own crew
• Physics-driven chaos and comedy
• A full open city to explore: beaches, boulevards, rooftops

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
GAME INFO
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
Developer: ELVORIS
Platform: PC - Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
Release: 2026
Modes: Single-player, Online Co-op
Languages: English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
